regions.today: Any mist and fog will clear this morning leaving a good deal of cloud for today with scattered showers and limited bright or sunny spells. Some of the showers may be heavy. Highest temperatures of 8 to 11 degrees in light to moderate northeasterly winds, fresher near coasts.
regions.tonight: A mix of cloud and clear spells tonight with well scattered showers and lowest temperatures of 1 to 7 degrees, coldest in the northwest of the province. Light to moderate northeasterly winds, fresher near eastern coasts at first, will ease through the night.
regions.tomorrow: Well scattered showers in the east and southeast will clear tomorrow morning to leave a largely dry day with spells of sunshine over the northern half of the province. Cloudier though for southern areas. Highest temperatures of 8 to 10 degrees in mostly light easterly or variable breezes.
